description: Read whether an AI agent can reach checkout for a brand the ARC Index already lists. No login and no new scan. Pass a brand, URL, or category. Returns the score, evidence, and both lanes: the agent-catalog HTTP check and the browser cart. The JSON field `agents_can_buy` is true when the catalog returned a checkout link or a browser shopper added the product to the cart. ARC stops before payment. It is not a completed order. The catalog check does not change the score. A missing score is not a zero. Results are advisory.

category.description: Index category or shopper words, e.g. footwear, running shoes, leggings.

q.description: Free-text brand, product, or category query.

url.description: Brand, store, or product URL already on the ARC Index.

name: ask_arc
